## Tuesday — Two managers, one engineer

::: {.case}
A balanced matrix in which a shared engineer is committed one hundred percent to two projects by two managers, each of whom has been told their project is the priority.

::: {.qn}
Nobody in this case did anything wrong. Name the structural feature that produced the failure — then say which structure would have prevented it, and what that structure costs.
:::
